decision: Adopt only the measured executable-artifact variant on Apple Silicon; preserve the full SDK recipe and other platform defaults. Reject the split and dynamic-executable alternatives.

protocol.candidate: same source, vanilla static executable; omit shared and combined library artifacts from executable output; preserve full library through lib.haskellExtension and rei-cli-library
protocol.budget: ten edits including differential setup, required verification, transfer and recurring maintenance
protocol.runtime: Compare commands/startup; preserve static executable linking and optimization. Dynamic-executable calibration rejected for 0.29-second startup regression.
protocol.correctness: Exact counterfactual reconstruction from the same full library scope, identical shared graph, complete supported suites, public library imports/GHCi and resource/type/stamp invalidation.
protocol.source_filters: unchanged; no file moves, new package, dependencies or pins

resources.concurrent_compilers: record; process presence alone never rejects a run
resources.limits: Host-wide samples, not CPU affinity or isolated builder accounting. Disk contention and thermal effects are not isolated; timing spread is checked separately.

native_suites.qualification: Complete owned suites on the frozen exact candidate; unchanged contract/client results are reused from their successful native runs. The later promoted revision includes separate user-authored API/core commits; its normal default builds and truthful stamp are verified separately.

core_change.qualification: One common core build plus ordinary downstream defaults. Add the same common cost to both sides; this phased attribution has an additional invocation/evaluation and is not a five-pair core speedup statistic.

runtime.qualification: Twenty warm alternating startup observations per command; static baseline has a behavior-neutral source comment. No build-speed acceptance is inferred.

worker_transfer.qualification: Independent local store seeded with the exact shared runtime closure. Missing outputs fail with builders and substituters disabled; copied original outputs then realise with matching NAR hashes and no compilation. Local transfer is not an internet-cache performance or cross-platform claim.

dotfiles.scope: Actual yujin package overlay, normal project pins with a read-only immutable source override; no activation.

promoted_dotfiles.scope: Actual yujin package overlay, normal project pins with a read-only immutable source override; no activation.

cost.common_costs: Complete family suites, native source guards and deployment assembly exist on both paths. Both guards and transfer are measured; neither saving is credited. Charge the entire 46.996-second fresh candidate build rather than taking credit for the baseline build it replaces. Optional simultaneous full-SDK/executable builds add cost and are outside the ordinary executable workflow.
cost.recurring_seed_generation_migration_or_e: None; no new package/source move/pin or checkpoint.
cost.history: Failed and alternative experiments retained in the raw archive are research history, not charged on every adoption/edit.

limits: Native Apple Silicon measurements only; other platform defaults preserved.
Independent local-store transfer with per-command no-check-sigs for locally built outputs is not hosted CI retrieval or internet transfer evidence; daemon trust is unchanged.
No remote push/cache publication, system activation or persistent database mutation.
301 compiler events remain; this is reduced artifact-generation work, not compiler intermediate reuse.
One initial candidate --version observation is 2.052 seconds; subsequent alternating warm startup medians agree. No cold-start speedup claim.
